content.subject: Financing update and finance ops at ShipMonk
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
ShipMonk reported $225M ARR and $300M raised. Such capital influx expands reconciliation workloads across finance systems, creating significant manual data matching bottlenecks.
We build bots that pull data from ledgers into a single audit table, eliminating manual entry.
Can we schedule a brief call next week to explore?
